d: Iran has said that security in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz can be restored in the shortest possible time if the United States fulfils its commitments. Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei said Tehran expects Washington to lift sanctions, end its naval blockade and implement the terms of the previously agreed memorandum of understanding on ending the regional war.
